title: A larger beam cross section
hook: Change cross-sectional area and predict power carried.
misconception: power carried stays fixed when cross-sectional area doubles.
objective: Apply P = IA to compare power carried when cross-sectional area changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a uniform beam with fixed intensity, P = IA. When cross-sectional area doubles, power carried becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model P = IA; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a uniform beam with fixed intensity, with a nonzero initial result. If cross-sectional area triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on power carried?
recall.why: Apply P = IA under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
